commit_message:
Fix Python HAL device creation params only last one used (#24812)

While using the Python bindings for the IREE runtime, I noticed that
only the last key-value pair in the dictionary passed as the `params`
argument to HalDriver's `create_device` method is actually consumed.

In the code below, pointers created using `c_str()` from the elements of
`param_strings` are stored in `passed_params`, but the issue is that if
`param_strings` is reallocated, those pointers become invalid.


https://github.com/iree-org/iree/blob/3c2a79f36e8b3333ffebb55c4afef1798581ccb5/runtime/bindings/python/hal.cc#L1133-L1145

In this PR, prevent reallocation by reserving the necessary space for
`param_strings` in advance.

Signed-off-by: Shogo Yamazaki <pgp@mocknen.net>
name: Tag candidate release

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@da1fb5cf9675

Bumps the llvm-project submodule from llvm/llvm-project@6ea395e4fe4d
to llvm/llvm-project@da1fb5cf9675. Clean fast-forward,
no carry-over reverts.

Adaptions needed:
- llvm/llvm-project@5835482e92cc moved the bufferization dialect's
  BufferizableOpInterface implementations out of the op definitions
  into external models that require explicit registration. Since IREE
  maintains its own dialect registry, update its codegen bufferization
  registration accordingly.
- llvm/llvm-project@bcbe2e2dbc6c added function-signature
  validation to the TOSA validation pass, enabled by default. The new
  checks reject dynamic dimensions at function boundaries with IREE's
  current TOSA target configuration. Disable signature validation in
  IREE's TOSA input pipeline, matching upstream's own
  tosa-to-linalg-pipeline.
- Regenerated the CAPI export files for the MLIR memory-effects C API
  changes in llvm/llvm-project@d04e49d9abec.

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>
name: setup / setup

commit_message:
[local-task] Clamp file read/write lengths to the platform transfer limit (#24816)

currently loading parameter files with "file" mode fails with:

```
IndexError: Error creating vm context with modules: external/+_repo_rules4+iree/runtime/src/iree/hal/drivers/local_task/task_queue.c:2714: OUT_OF_RANGE; short read: requested 13282859520 bytes, got 397957632; while invoking native function hal.fence.await; while calling variadic import;
```

The io_uring and IOCP backends narrowed the span length to their native
transfer count (sqe->len is 32 bits, ReadFile/WriteFile take a DWORD).
Spans over 4GB transferred the wrong amount, and a span that is an exact
multiple of 4GB wrapped to zero: the operation completed successfully
having moved no bytes, which the caller cannot distinguish from EOF.

Clamp instead. Short transfers are part of the file read/write contract,
so callers resubmit for the remainder. The ceiling is INT_MAX rounded
down to a page, matching the kernel's MAX_RW_COUNT.

Adds a CTS test covering the exact-4GB case, using a sparse reservation
so the oversized span costs address space rather than committed memory.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Signed-off-by: Thomas Ziereis <ziereis@roofline.ai>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit_message:
[iree-benchmark-module] transfer outputs to host in case of enable_output_processing (#24821)

The enable_output_processing feature added to iree-benchmark_module in
commit a70389bb8b [iree-benchmark-module] support processing outputs
after benchmarking (#24789) did not call
iree_tooling_transfer_variants() to make sure the output buffers are
host accessible. So depending on the device used for benchmarking, the
outputs could be accessed on the host to dump those or to check those.
This PR fixes this by calling iree_tooling_transfer_variants() in case
output processing is enabled. This is the same handling as in
iree-run-module.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
name: linux_x64_gcc

commit a70389bb8b [iree-benchmark-module] support processing outputs
after benchmarking (#24789) did not call
iree_tooling_transfer_variants() to make sure the output buffers are
host accessible. So depending on the device used for benchmarking, the
outputs could be accessed on the host to dump those or to check those.
This PR fixes this by calling iree_tooling_transfer_variants() in case
output processing is enabled. This is the same handling as in
iree-run-module.

commit_message:
[iree-benchmark-module] transfer outputs to host in case of enable_output_processing

The enable_output_processing feature added to iree-benchmark_module in commit
a70389bb8b [iree-benchmark-module] support processing outputs after benchmarking (#24789)
did not call iree_tooling_transfer_variants() to make sure the output buffers are
host accessible. So depending on the device used for benchmarking, the outputs could
be accessed on the host to dump those or to check those. This PR fixes this by
calling iree_tooling_transfer_variants() in case output processing is enabled.
This is the same handling as in iree-run-module.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
name: pre-commit

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@d37fa5a838db

Bumps the llvm-project submodule from llvm/llvm-project@6ea395e4fe4d
to llvm/llvm-project@d37fa5a838db. Clean fast-forward,
no carry-over reverts. The pin includes upstream's revert of
llvm/llvm-project@703f0ae7e68f (FoldingSet CRTP removal), which broke
MSVC builds.

Adaptions needed:
- llvm/llvm-project@5835482e92cc moved the bufferization dialect's
  BufferizableOpInterface implementations out of the op definitions
  into external models that require explicit registration. Since IREE
  maintains its own dialect registry, update its codegen bufferization
  registration accordingly.
- llvm/llvm-project@bcbe2e2dbc6c added function-signature
  validation to the TOSA validation pass, enabled by default. The new
  checks reject dynamic dimensions at function boundaries with IREE's
  current TOSA target configuration. Disable signature validation in
  IREE's TOSA input pipeline, matching upstream's own
  tosa-to-linalg-pipeline.
- Regenerated the CAPI export files for the MLIR memory-effects C API
  changes in llvm/llvm-project@d04e49d9abec.

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[local-task] Clamp file read/write lengths to the platform transfer limit (#24816)

currently loading parameter files with "file" mode fails with:

```
IndexError: Error creating vm context with modules: external/+_repo_rules4+iree/runtime/src/iree/hal/drivers/local_task/task_queue.c:2714: OUT_OF_RANGE; short read: requested 13282859520 bytes, got 397957632; while invoking native function hal.fence.await; while calling variadic import;
```

The io_uring and IOCP backends narrowed the span length to their native
transfer count (sqe->len is 32 bits, ReadFile/WriteFile take a DWORD).
Spans over 4GB transferred the wrong amount, and a span that is an exact
multiple of 4GB wrapped to zero: the operation completed successfully
having moved no bytes, which the caller cannot distinguish from EOF.

Clamp instead. Short transfers are part of the file read/write contract,
so callers resubmit for the remainder. The ceiling is INT_MAX rounded
down to a page, matching the kernel's MAX_RW_COUNT.

Adds a CTS test covering the exact-4GB case, using a sparse reservation
so the oversized span costs address space rather than committed memory.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Signed-off-by: Thomas Ziereis <ziereis@roofline.ai>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@da1fb5cf9675

Bumps the llvm-project submodule from llvm/llvm-project@6ea395e4fe4d
to llvm/llvm-project@da1fb5cf9675. Clean fast-forward,
no carry-over reverts.

Adaptions needed:
- llvm/llvm-project@5835482e92cc moved the bufferization dialect's
  BufferizableOpInterface implementations out of the op definitions
  into external models that require explicit registration. Since IREE
  maintains its own dialect registry, update its codegen bufferization
  registration accordingly.
- llvm/llvm-project@bcbe2e2dbc6c added function-signature
  validation to the TOSA validation pass, enabled by default. The new
  checks reject dynamic dimensions at function boundaries with IREE's
  current TOSA target configuration. Disable signature validation in
  IREE's TOSA input pipeline, matching upstream's own
  tosa-to-linalg-pipeline.
- Regenerated the CAPI export files for the MLIR memory-effects C API
  changes in llvm/llvm-project@d04e49d9abec.

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[iree-benchmark-module] transfer outputs to host in case of enable_output_processing (#24821)

The enable_output_processing feature added to iree-benchmark_module in
commit a70389bb8b [iree-benchmark-module] support processing outputs
after benchmarking (#24789) did not call
iree_tooling_transfer_variants() to make sure the output buffers are
host accessible. So depending on the device used for benchmarking, the
outputs could be accessed on the host to dump those or to check those.
This PR fixes this by calling iree_tooling_transfer_variants() in case
output processing is enabled. This is the same handling as in
iree-run-module.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
name: macos_arm64_clang

Bumps the llvm-project submodule from llvm/llvm-project@6ea395e4fe4d
to llvm/llvm-project@d37fa5a838db. Clean fast-forward,

  validation to the TOSA validation pass, enabled by default. The new
  checks reject dynamic dimensions at function boundaries with IREE's
  current TOSA target configuration. Disable signature validation in
  IREE's TOSA input pipeline, matching upstream's own
  tosa-to-linalg-pipeline.
